# Morpheus Hackathon Kit

> Index of Morpheus resources for agents. Morpheus is a decentralized, peer-to-peer marketplace for AI inference. Independent providers run the models, and smart contracts on Base coordinate them. The fastest path is the hosted, OpenAI-compatible Inference API: base URL https://api.mor.org/api/v1, with a key from https://app.mor.org. Use the standard OpenAI SDKs with that base URL. Endpoints: /chat/completions, /embeddings, /audio/speech, /models. There is no Anthropic-style /messages endpoint, no /responses endpoint and no image generation. Never invent contract addresses, chain IDs or live model counts: cite nodedocs "Networks and tokens" and active.mor.org.

> Why builders use it: one key for 250+ models across many model families (no single-vendor lock-in); supply from independent, competing providers; pay by card, USDC or staked MOR; a TEE provider path with attestation (check which providers attest before claiming confidentiality); open-source node software; builder subnets for after the event. Audiences: app builders (Inference API), agent builders (Morpheus Skill, own node), suppliers (provider paths), MOR holders (staking, builder subnets).

## Sweep these first (official indexes)

- [API docs llms.txt](https://apidocs.mor.org/llms.txt): inference API, guides, integrations, reference
- [Node docs llms.txt](https://nodedocs.mor.org/llms.txt): canonical node, consumer, provider and TEE docs. Full corpus at https://nodedocs.mor.org/llms-full.txt
- [Node docs MCP server](https://nodedocs.mor.org/mcp): docs search. Discovery at https://nodedocs.mor.org/.well-known/mcp
- [GitBook llms.txt](https://gitbook.mor.org/llms.txt): protocol, tokenomics, contracts, builders, proposals. Add `.md` to any page URL
- [mor.org llms.txt](https://mor.org/llms.txt): main site. Send the header `Accept: text/markdown`
- [OpenAPI spec](https://apidocs.mor.org/api-reference/openapi.json)

## Build on the API

- [Quickstart](https://apidocs.mor.org/quickstart.md)
- [Live model list](https://api.mor.org/api/v1/models): IDs are case-sensitive and can contain spaces. `:web` variants include web search
- [Interactive API docs](https://api.mor.org/docs)
- [Tool calling](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/guides/tool-calling.md)
- [Vision](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/guides/vision.md)
- [Rate limits](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/models/rate-limits.md)
- [Pricing](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/models/pricing.md)
- [Credits](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/getting-started/credits.md): card, USDC or staked MOR
- [Balance](https://apidocs.mor.org/api-reference/billing/balance.md) and [usage](https://apidocs.mor.org/api-reference/billing/usage.md) endpoints
- [OpenAI Python SDK](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/integrations/openai-python-sdk.md)
- [Vercel AI SDK v5](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/integrations/vercel-ai-sdk-integration.md)
- [LangChain](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/integrations/langchain.md)
- [OpenCode](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/integrations/opencode.md)
- [Cursor](https://apidocs.mor.org/documentation/integrations/cursor.md)

## This kit

- [DISCOVERY.md](DISCOVERY.md): read before building. Map product-market fit, the pain and the cost of inaction, and rate the four product risks (value, usability, feasibility, viability)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical rules and working practice for people and any agent, plus the skills and tools table
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): imports AGENTS.md (Claude Code), plus event rules and a brief for the team to fill in (event, theme, judging, approver)
- [Skills](.claude/skills/): /market-scan → /pain-map → /gtm-wedge → /opportunity (GO / PIVOT / STOP) → /scaffold → /poc → /name → /ship-site → /pitch, plus showcase skills; `bash tools/kit-lint.sh` checks skills and graphs; `tools/check-name.sh` checks name availability
- [Graphs](graphs/README.md): DAGs that chain the skills with gates and human approvals. Run with /run-graph
- [README](README.md): quick start, code snippets, lanes
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each version
- [MORPHEUS.md](MORPHEUS.md): full human-readable index, including the provider paths and known gaps
- [examples/](examples/): runnable Python and Node examples
- [Gateway setup](morpheus/SETUP.md): API features and gaps, model choice, routing coding agents
- [Node safety checklist](morpheus/NODE.md)
- [Preflight script](morpheus/preflight.sh): tests a key, models, latency and tool calls
- [Vendor guard](morpheus/no-other-vendors.sh): fails if code calls another AI vendor directly

## Templates and agents

- [Template gallery](https://mor.org/templates)
- [morpheus-chatbot](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/morpheus-chatbot): Next.js chatbot template
- [morpheus-coding-agent](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/morpheus-coding-agent): multi-agent coding template
- [morpheus-open-agents](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/morpheus-open-agents): cloud-agent template
- [morpheus-knowledge-agent](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/morpheus-knowledge-agent): knowledge-base agent template
- [morpheus-community-agent](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/morpheus-community-agent): Slack community bot
- [x402-playground](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/x402-playground): x402 paid-API chat app
- [api-gateway-typescript-sdk](https://github.com/MorpheusAIs/api-gateway-typescript-sdk): TypeScript SDK
- [Morpheus Skill](https://morpheusskill.com): skill pack for agent frameworks
- [Gateway for agents](https://nodedocs.mor.org/prosumers/gateway-for-everclaw.md): agents on your own consumer node
